title.narrative: Activity under preparation Scaling up EU-India Global Gateway Policy Dialogues

description.narrative: The Overall Objective (Impact) is to deliver on the Comprehensive Strategic Agenda endorsed at the India-EU Summit 2026 with a focus on Global Gateway strategy priorities.The Specific Objective (Outcome) is to support results- and investment-oriented, gender-responsive policy dialogues specifically regarding clean energy and climate, sustainable urbanisation, resource efficiency and circular economy, water, digitalisation and standardisation as well as other emerging EU-India Partnership policy priorities. (Clean Energy and Climate Partnership).Output 2- Strengthened policy dialogue on smart and sustainable urbanisation, with a focus on promoting climate resilient, inclusive, and integrated planning and governance models, including participatory approaches involving local authorities and civil society, while enhancing institutional capacities to effectively manage complex urban systems.
